As models become more intelligent, without the right safeguards and monitoring they also become more dangerous. These issues are complex, thorny, and increasingly important for everyone to understand so that the world can weigh in and respond to rapidly escalating risks.

results.text: We are in a weird moment: coding is automated, but the rest — system design, code review, and so on — are not yet fully automated. For the next 6-12 months, some engineering skills you learn in school will remain critical for people that write software. After that, they will become basic “background” skills you learn in school, like geometry and history are today. You don’t use these every day but they give you frameworks and ways of thinking about the world that come in handy later on.
